transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, honestly, what really made me come in is... I just can't shake this feeling that people at work are out to get me. I'm a buyer for a retail company, and I know that some of my coworkers, and even some of the vendors I deal with, are tracking my buys. They're messing with the launch numbers just to make me look stupid. My supervisor keeps showing me the reports and saying there's no proof of it, but I just know they're doing it.
Have you always been this suspicious and distrustful of other people, or is this a new change for you?

No, I haven't always been like this. It's definitely a newer change. Um, I'd say these suspicious feelings about everyone... and, well, the voice I've been hearing, too... it's all been happening for roughly ten months now.
Have you been having these symptoms continuously for the past six months?
Yeah, it's been pretty constant. I mean, there hasn't really been a break from it. So, yes, definitely continuously for the last six months. It just hasn't stopped.
Have you also had periods of feeling unusually depressed or abnormally energized and full of energy during this time?

Yeah, there have been times where I get this... huge burst of energy. Like, I get really keyed up. When that happens, I can't just focus on one thing. I'll be emailing three different vendors at the same time, trying to write up a new buy plan, reorganizing all the product samples on my desk... and I'll just be pacing around the office while I do it. It feels like if I stop moving, I'll completely lose my train of thought. So, yeah, definitely periods where I'm just abnormally energized like that.
During those high-energy periods, did your mood also feel unusually elevated or euphoric?

Yeah, I do. Um, I get these stretches where I just feel amazing, like... like the whole city is opening up for me, you know? But then, if someone questions a purchase order I'm putting together, or if they tell me I need to slow down, I just... I snap at them. Way harder than I mean to. I get really irritated if anyone gets in my way.
Have the suspicious beliefs and the voice been present even when you were not having those high-energy or euphoric periods?

Yeah, they have. Um, even during the calmer stretches... like when I was actually sleeping normally and not feeling like I was running the whole market... I still had them. There was a period of a few weeks where my mood was pretty normal, but I still totally believed people were tracking my buys. And I was still hearing that voice when I was back in the stockroom. So, yeah, those things don't really go away even when my energy levels out.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least two weeks when the hearing the voice or the suspicious beliefs were still there even though you were not having any manic or depressed symptoms at all?

Yeah, exactly. Like I was just saying, there was a stretch of a few weeks where my mood was totally fine. I wasn't super energized, I was sleeping okay, and I definitely wasn't depressed or anything. But even during that calm time, I still completely believed people were tracking my buys, and I was still hearing that voice when I'd go back into the stockroom. So, yeah, it was at least a couple of weeks where those things were happening without any of the mood stuff.
Have there been any times during these ten months when your mood symptoms—feeling unusually energized or depressed—lasted for most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yeah, definitely. Um, honestly, looking back at it, most of the time since this all started has been taken up by those wired or irritable stretches. Like, I'd be overworking, feeling really overconfident, and just... it was hard to slow me down. Those periods would last for weeks at a time, pretty much all day, every day. The calmer periods I mentioned before, they were really just shorter stretches in between all that energy. So, yeah, the energized stuff has been there for the majority of the time.
Have you ever had a significant period of depression during these ten months?

No, not really. Um, I haven't had anything like that. I haven't felt really down or, you know, sad for any long stretches. It's mostly just been feeling super wired like I said, or just normal. But no, I wouldn't say I've been depressed.
When the suspicious beliefs or the voice happen, do they ever show up when you are not also having a manic-like episode?

Yeah, like I mentioned earlier, they definitely do. Um, even during a calmer stretch when I was actually sleeping more normally and not feeling like I was running the whole market, I still spent a few weeks believing people were tracking my buys. And I was still hearing that voice when I'd go into the stockroom. So, yes, they still show up even when I'm not all wired up.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least one full month when the hearing the voice or the suspicious beliefs were still there even though you were not having any manic or depressed symptoms at all?

Um, well, like I was just saying, there was that calmer stretch where I was sleeping more normally and didn't feel like I was running the whole market. But, um, I don't know if it was a full month. It was really just a few weeks where I still believed people were tracking my buys and I kept hearing that voice in the stockroom. So, yeah, it happened without the wired feelings, but it was just for a few weeks, probably not a whole month straight.
Have you ever had a full month where the voice and suspicious beliefs were still there even though you were not having any manic symptoms at all?
Um, no, not a full month. Like I said, it was just a few weeks where I felt normal but still had all the... the tracking stuff and the voice. But not a whole month, no.
Have you ever had a full month when the voice and suspicious beliefs were still there but you were not having any manic symptoms at all?

No, I really haven't. Like I've been trying to say, it was just those couple of weeks where the voice and the tracking stuff were happening without me feeling all wired and up. It definitely hasn't ever been a whole month like that.
Have you ever had any period of at least two weeks when you were hearing the voice or believing people were tracking you, and your mood was completely normal the whole time?

Yeah, exactly. That's what I've been trying to say. It was at least two weeks. I had that calmer stretch where my mood was totally normal—I was sleeping normally again, and I didn't feel like I was running the whole market anymore. But even then, I still spent a few weeks believing people were tracking my buys, and I was still hearing that voice in the stockroom. So, yes, it was definitely at least two weeks.
Have the times when you were hearing the voice or believing people were tracking you made up most of the time since this started, or were they present only during shorter episodes?

Well, looking back on it... most of the time since this all started hasn't really been just the voice and the tracking on their own. The majority of it has actually been taken up by those wired or irritable stretches. You know, the times when I was overworking, feeling super confident, and just really hard to slow down. Those calmer periods in between were definitely a lot shorter. Mostly, it's been the wired stuff.
Have you ever had a full month when the voice and suspicious beliefs were still there but you were not having any manic symptoms at all?

I think we actually just talked about this, but no. It's never been a full month. Like I said a minute ago, it was really just that two-week stretch where my mood was completely normal but I was still dealing with the voice and the tracking stuff. It definitely never went on for a whole month like that.
Have you ever had a major depressive episode lasting at least two weeks?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really had any periods where I felt super depressed or down for that long. Like I said, it's mostly been the wired stuff, where I'm going a million miles an hour. I haven't had any times where I just couldn't get out of bed or anything like that.
Have you ever had any period of at least two weeks when you were hearing the voice or believing people were tracking you, and you were not having any manic symptoms at all?

Yeah, actually. There was a stretch for a few weeks where things were calmer. I was sleeping a normal amount and I didn't have that feeling like I was running the whole market or anything. But even then, during that normal time, I still believed people were tracking my buys, and I was still hearing that voice when I was in the stockroom. So, yeah, I've had that happen for at least two weeks without the wired stuff.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least two weeks when you were hearing the voice or believing people were tracking you, and your mood was completely normal the whole time?

Yeah, I think that's what I was just saying a second ago. But yes, exactly that. I had a calmer stretch for a few weeks where my mood was totally normal. I was sleeping normally, and I didn't feel like I was running the whole market anymore. 

But even during that normal time, I still spent those few weeks believing people were tracking my buys, and I kept hearing that voice when I was in the stockroom. So, yeah, my mood was fine, but that other stuff was definitely still happening.
During this ten-month period, have you had any stretch of at least two weeks when you felt depressed or down most of the day nearly every day?

No, I haven't. Like I mentioned earlier, I haven't really dealt with feeling depressed or down like that. It's really just been the wired, fast-paced stuff or feeling totally normal, but not depressed.
